title: Scala compile failures
hypothesis: At least 70% of seeded code faults are repaired within 3 attempts; repeated fingerprints escalate; forbidden APIs never run.

gates_run: 5 fixture tests (only if 1-4 pass; not cached)
config.attempts: each detected fault's gates are run twice on the identical artifact; both results go through classify and RunBudget.record_fingerprint
config.repair_measurement: not possible here: rewriting a generated slot needs an LLM provider and none is configured (ADR-0003), so `generate` re-renders identical code on every attempt. See the module docstring.
